title: The Nanki-Shirahama Mystery Tour
notes: Detective-cast (Kogoro, Ran, Conan) omitted by convention. Rebuilt from the full two-part subtitle transcript; the old wiki-derived case file at cases/ep236-237_the_nanki_shirahama_mystery_tour.json had the correct culprit (Kanako Miyahara) and victim (Maki Shinjo) already, so label.murderer_id is unchanged, but it was missing almost everything else: the red-herring accusation against Kota Fuji (Kogoro wrongly accuses him mid-episode using nearly the same accusatory speech later redirected at the real culprit -- a deliberate misdirection by the show), Fuji's real secret (an affair with Madoka Mitsui, concealed from both Yura and the victim), the two police detectives (O'ura, Ando), the backstory of Kanako's fraudulent university admission arranged by Maki's father and the blackmail Maki held over her ever since, and the forensic/physical clue chain (coil-type keychain missing only the car key, doctored Adventure World photos vs. orca-trainer staffing testimony, saliva/blood-type match on Maki's irreplaceable Paris-imported lipstick) that the old file collapsed into a single vague 'gloves' clue. The old file also omitted that Maki herself had premeditated a murder of Madoka (the gloves in her jacket were for that), and that Kanako's crime was a betrayal of that very plan rather than incidental. case_type: murder.

clues.desc: Maki's keychain is a coil-type ring (hard to strip a key from) yet only the rental car key is missing while her house keys remain attached -- a genuine robber grabbing the keys in a struggle would take the whole ring, so the car key must have been handed over voluntarily, meaning the killer was someone Maki trusted, not a stranger.

Comparing Fuji's digital-camera photos (showing a braided-hair woman at the orca show) against the orca trainer's testimony that the same staff were on duty the entire day proves the photos were taken on a different visit and edited to look current -- his claimed unbroken alibi is fabricated.

Maki's lipstick is a one-of-a-kind Paris import with no substitute sold in Japan, yet forensic saliva/blood-type analysis of the residue on it belongs to Kanako, not Maki -- proof Kanako was wearing Maki's lipstick while impersonating her at Shirahama Station.
